Each aging round was followed by a reference performance test, with 58 rounds for two cells and 53 rounds for the third.

source_metadata.purpose: Battery degradation is critical to the cost-effectiveness and usability of battery-powered products. Aging studies can help to better understand and model degradation and to optimize the operation strategy. Nevertheless, there are only a few comprehensive and freely available aging datasets for these applications.

title: LG INR18650-HG2 Capacity and Impedance Aging Dataset

The consortium profile also lists eleven other cell products, but those rows are a membership catalogue rather than eleven public datasets, so they are not duplicated here as downloadable cell variants.
